_comment: HOST vs APP boundary — the release-decision rule:
runtime/host/   = frozen into the host exe. ANY edit here is dormant until the
next host-vX.Y.Z release; treat every diff in this folder as a
runtime/app/    = ships in the app-layer zip (app-vX.Y.Z), updated frequently.
Some app/ modules are ALSO bundled into the exe (bootstrap.js
requires them across the folder line); they are listed below under
'dual_shipped' so their edits still count as host changes too.
check_host_manifest.js (CI: build-runtime-host.yml) verifies this manifest matches the
actual require closure of host/bootstrap.js. Add entries whenever that graph changes.
